english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the crime of breaking in to steal.

examples.english: There have been more burglary incidents in this area lately, so remember to lock your doors and windows at night.
examples.traditional: 呢區最近爆竊多咗，大家夜晚記得鎖好門窗。
